summary: The government's proposed state budget for 2027, prepared by the Ministry of Finance and State Enterprises and presented to Parliament under Article 96(h) of the Constitution. It sets out expected revenue, planned spending, the deficit and how it will be financed, along with economic forecasts and estimates for 2028 and 2029. This summary describes the budget as presented, not an assessment of it; Parliament still has to review and vote on it.
keyPoints: Total state budget for 2027 is MVR 59,704.4 million, about 7% less than the 2026 figure of MVR 64,200.4 million
Revenue including grants is expected at MVR 43,158.1 million: MVR 33,639.9 million in tax, MVR 9,168.9 million non-tax and MVR 349.3 million in grants
Spending of MVR 52,600.6 million leaves a deficit of MVR 9,442.5 million, forecast at 7.3% of GDP (primary deficit 3.4%)
Forecasts include inflation rising from 0.6% in 2026 to 3.9% in 2027, and official reserves growing from USD 817.7 million to USD 907.2 million
outcome: Presented to Parliament; review and vote pending
